summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Controladora Vuela Compañía de Aviación (Volaris) reporting a press release that announces the resignation of board director Andrew Broderick, effective June 15, 2026, to pursue a new professional challenge. The press release expresses gratitude for his service but does not disclose any forced departure, material fees, or replacement terms. No special-situation event—such as an activist campaign, strategic review, or management change involving a sudden CEO/CFO exit—is present. This is a routine director resignation in the ordinary course of business, thus not a special situation.
